column7: What are key mimics of varicocele on scrotal ultrasound?
column8: Hernia; epididymitis; tubular ectasia of the rete testis; spermatocele/epididymal cyst; rare vascular lesions; testicular torsion.
column9:
Varicocele: serpiginous veins with Valsalva-dependent venous reflux/flow.
Hernia: fat/bowel displaces testis; gut signature or peristalsis.
Epididymitis: enlarged hyperemic epididymis separate from pampiniform plexus.
Tubular ectasia: avascular mediastinal tubules with no Doppler flow.
Attribution: [Both] with STATdx-expanded differential.
column21:
Differential pivot: Varicocele: serpiginous veins with Valsalva-dependent venous reflux/flow.
Hernia: fat/bowel displaces testis; gut signature or peristalsis.

Tubular ectasia: avascular mediastinal tubules with no Doppler flow.
Attribution: [Both] with STATdx-expanded differential.

column7: How do you distinguish tubular ectasia of the rete testis from intratesticular varicocele?
